status: WRITTEN all-variable sublemma toward the general Schur-coupling kernel condition, UNREVIEWED; not a new normal-class physical T2 claim
finding: For any nonzero NORMAL traceless A,B∈M4, equality S2(A⊗I+I⊗B)=2L forces σ2>σ3, so every maximizing rank-two P is the unique top-two spectral projector. Consequently, when such A,B are already 2+2 block diagonal, P commutes with their four sector projectors and both first-unpaid partial-trace kernel identities hold.
proof: Locally diagonalize A,B with tracezero eigenvectors a,b. For two distinct positions (i,j),(k,l), the 2×2 Gram matrix of the two evaluation functionals (a,b)↦(a_i+b_j,a_k+b_l) on the tracezero Hilbert space is [[3/2,κ],[κ,3/2]] with κ=δ_ik+δ_jl−1/2∈{−1/2,+1/2}. Its top eigenvalue 2 is simple. If both local indices differ, equality forces a=t(e_i−e_k), b=t(e_j−e_l), giving exactly two modulus-2|t| entries and all others ≤|t|. If they share one index, equality forces a=t[2e_i−(1/2)1], b=t[e_j+e_l−(1/2)1] or the swapped case, again exactly two modulus-2|t| entries and all others ≤|t|. t≠0 for nonzero pair. Within-block diagonalizations preserve the original sector projections.
